title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Pineapple Peach Mango
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kits Only Keep your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K device flowing with flavour with the Pineapple Peach Mango Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod plus a 10ml refill container, together delivering up to 10,000 puffs of smooth, consistent flavour. Preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, the pod and refill system offers a simple and reliable way to enjoy vaping with the Dojo Blast kit, supported by Vaporesso’s COREX 2.0 dual mesh coil and Smart Liq-Cycle saturation technology. Pineapple Peach Mango combines three sun-soaked fruits into one vibrant tropical blend. The tangy punch of golden Pineapple leads the way, followed by the soft, velvety sweetness of Peach and the juicy, exotic richness of Mango. This trio creates a layered and sunny profile that is bursting with fruitiness. With transparent pods and a clean refill system, managing e-liquid levels is straightforward and fuss-free.
